description: This file contains mock implementations of the IMathSolver interface and related classes for testing purposes within the GraphingImpl namespace. It defines classes for parsing options, evaluation options, format options, expressions, variables, and a mock math solver that provides stubbed methods for parsing input, creating graph objects, and analyzing graph functions.

classes.name: ParsingOptions
classes.description: Mock implementation of IParsingOptions, allows setting format and localization types.

classes.name: EvalOptions
classes.description: Mock implementation of IEvalOptions, manages trig unit mode.

classes.name: FormatOptions
classes.description: Mock implementation of IFormatOptions, allows setting format type, MathML prefix, and localization.

classes.name: MockExpression
classes.description: Mock implementation of IExpression, provides stub methods for expression ID and empty set check.

classes.name: MockVariable
classes.description: Mock implementation of IVariable, provides variable ID and name.

classes.name: MathSolver
classes.description: Mock implementation of IMathSolver, provides methods for parsing input, creating graphs, and analyzing functions.

methods.name: GetTrigUnitMode
methods.description: Returns the current trig unit mode.

methods.name: ParseInput
methods.description: Parses a string input into an expression, returns a MockExpression or nullptr if input is empty.

methods.name: CreateGrapher
methods.description: Creates a graph object from an expression (stub).
